description: This file contains helper functions and scripts used for interactive rebase testing, including setting fake editors, verifying rebase sequences, and handling reword operations within a git rebase process.

methods.name: set_fake_editor
methods.description: Sets up a fake editor script to override the default git editor during tests, enabling control over commit messages and rebase scripts.

methods.name: set_cat_todo_editor
methods.description: Configures a fake editor to output the rebase todo list to stdout for verification purposes.

methods.name: test_linear_range
methods.description: Verifies that a sequence of commits forms a linear range with expected subjects.

methods.name: reset_rebase
methods.description: Aborts any ongoing rebase, resets the repository to a clean state.

methods.name: cherry_pick
methods.description: Performs a git cherry-pick, commits with a message, and tags the commit.

methods.name: revert
methods.description: Reverts a commit, commits with a message, and tags the revert.

methods.name: make_empty
methods.description: Creates an empty commit with a message and tags it.

methods.name: test_editor_unchanged
methods.description: Checks that environment variables related to editors are unchanged.

methods.name: set_reword_editor
methods.description: Sets up a scripted editor to handle reword commands during rebase, ensuring reworded commits retain original authorship.

methods.name: check_reworded_commits
methods.description: Verifies that commits have been correctly reworded and that the rebase process resulted as expected.

methods.name: set_replace_editor
methods.description: Replaces the rebase todo list with a specific file's contents, used for testing reordering and editing.
